descriptionHtml:
ASUS Vivobook 16 V3607VH-EG005W Laptop - Intel Core 5 210H - RTX 5050 8GB - 16GB RAM - Windows 11 - Matte Black

Experience a perfect blend of sleek productivity and next-generation graphics acceleration with the ASUS Vivobook 16 V3607VH-EG005W high-performance laptop, distributed via Turbo Computer Egypt. Powered by the efficient Intel Core 5 210H processor and equipped with 16GB of high-speed DDR5 memory, this system provides fluid multitasking capability for creators and professionals alike. Visuals are driven by the groundbreaking NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 dedicated graphics engine with a massive 8GB VRAM, delivering stunning realism and creative power to a brilliant 16.0-inch FHD+ display with a smooth 144Hz refresh rate. Finished in an elegant Matte Black aesthetic, this modern laptop comes factory-loaded with a licensed Windows 11 Home operating system and is officially backed by a 1-year Perfect Warranty against manufacturing defects.
